differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Severe CKD (Cr 3.2 mg/dL) in a 70‑y/o with long‑standing hypertension and hyperlipidemia, typical for vascular renal injury.

differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Prediabetes plus CKD; early diabetic kidney disease can present with modest proteinuria and rising creatinine before overt diabetes.

differential.name: Analgesic (NSAID) nephropathy
differential.rationale: Chronic pain and likely long‑term NSAID/acetaminophen use can cause interstitial nephritis and CKD with preserved albumin.

differential.name: Renal artery stenosis (ischemic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: History of myocardial infarction and atherosclerotic disease predisposes to renal artery narrowing leading to CKD.

differential.name: Iron‑deficiency anemia secondary to chronic GI blood loss
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 42 fL) with recurrent rectal polyps suggests ongoing occult bleeding.
